reviewMethod: Provisional independent assistant visual review, model-blind. Selected 48 rounded evenly spaced indices across numeric-ID sorted remaining eligible v_c_b recordings >=4s (119 eligible at selection), excluding every prior review ID/hash regardless of decision. Directly inspected all 48 timestamped 24-frame full-context sheets via view_image. Sequentially decoded using one OpenCV decoder and cv2.setNumThreads(1); every successful read used actual CAP_PROP_POS_MSEC, required finite and strictly increasing, no FPS-derived time. Directly inspected all ordered all-source-frame contact-sheet pages for 22 candidates; also wider all-frame pages for 134 and 209, and 13 enlarged 3-frame detail sheets. Dense source frames support every loader-eligible accepted four-second window. Visual judgments entered manually after inspection; no classifier execution, scores, audio or continuous-motion playback.
limitations: Assistant visual labels are provisional, not human ground truth or continuous-motion playback. Static images cannot establish force, intent, actual impacts, identity, injury or crime.

Screening samples only 24 full-context frames per recording. Dense candidates include every successfully decoded source frame as resized, timestamped ordered crops; blur, occlusion and image size limit certainty. Crops can cut peripheral people; wider pages and enlarged details supplement disputed interactions.
Conservative positive intervals only; unannotated setup, releases, occluded gaps and tails are unknown, never normal. No label 0 events. No boundary was extended to obtain window eligibility.
Props/weapons and prop-centred chair setups excluded. Brief or uncertain contact and gesture-only imagery remain ambiguous. No accepted-count target was forced.

All VID material is one unresolved training cohort, vid-v2-unresolved-session-cohort. Scene tags are descriptive only; no calibration or holdout and no independent-actor/session claim. Overlapping windows are dependent observations.

Pinned existing official archive records document copyright provenance only. Participant consent is author-reported; no independent participant-release or full non-copyright rights clearance. Raw footage/evidence stays local and ignored.

Only existing imported footage reviewed; no downloads, installs, new archives, GPU/model/inference/training, service/live changes, commits/deployments or external messages. Parent owns merging and any GPU work.
